assets.prompt: Use case illustration-story; 1000x760 landscape fantasy card artwork. Strictly follow image1 action pose, image2 Wylder identity, image3 flat graphic rendering. Wylder closed silver feather-wing helmet with black visor, black scarf, navy coat with white water motifs, silver grouped scale armor, brown gloves. Two arms, two legs with continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand joints. Chunky silhouettes, large hard-edge flat cel color planes, minimal texture. One physically rigid greatsword, straight blade/grip axis, open forked pommel, no bent steel or extra weapons. No text, UI or card frame. Lower-third character crouches forward in rear-side view, two separate connected arms grip the same ONE straight greatsword and perform a low horizontal sweep toward right. Display sword in the foreground, near-horizontal line from distinct OPEN TWO-PRONG FORKED POMMEL on left, through blue grip and two gloves, silver guard and rigid straight blade pointing right. Pommel must be OPEN, visibly TWO separate swept silver prongs with a gap, not a closed diamond or ring. An orange-yellow flaming sweep arcs from lower-left toward upper-right behind the blade; do not obscure hands. Simplified warm dark russet flat background, no UI or landscape.

Expose a small distinctive silver OPEN FORKED pommel, with two swept pointed prongs and dark negative space, at the left end of the blue grip, extending horizontally LEFT away from both hands. It must visibly connect to the same single grip. Keep pommel stem, grip, guard, straight blade ridge and tip exactly COLLINEAR on one nearly horizontal axis from left to right. No second handle, no extra hand or fingers. Preserve the sword's rigid straight blade and all non-hilt artwork.
